output_list.reason: Integer overflow in mintToken function allows the owner to set the balance of an arbitrary user to any value.
Integer overflow in sell function allows a potential trap due to overflow of 'amount * sellPrice', aka 'tradeTrap' issue.
Integer overflow in buy function allows a potential trap due to overflow of 'amount * buyPrice', aka 'tradeTrap' issue.
Integer overflow in transfer function allows a potential trap due to overflow of 'balanceOf[_to] += _value', aka 'tradeTrap' issue.
mintToken function allows attackers to acquire tokens arbitrarily, aka 'mintTrap' issue.
